Create a production-oriented PIXEL ART full-body fighting-game pose atlas, using the attached drawing as the identity reference. Exactly 32 separate complete figures in a regular 4-column by 8-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each cell contains exactly ONE actor, facing RIGHT in a consistent three-quarter side view. Orthographic 2D sprite art; crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading, no anti-aliased painterly rendering. Use the SAME face, head size, long body proportions and limb lengths in every cell. The feet and every extended limb must fit wholly inside its own cell with generous empty margins. Flat solid pure magenta #ff00ff background everywhere, no ground lines, labels, numbers, grid lines, shadows, motion trails or floating effects. One connected character silhouette per cell; hands, feet, neck and any worn accessory are visibly attached. Most important anatomy: the TWO LEGS grow from the LOWEST LOWER BODY/PELVIS beneath the elongated torso, close to the base, NEVER from the chest, shoulders, mid-torso or neck. Preserve two arms and two legs only; never leave a duplicate limb baked into the body. During kicks, the low hip rotates, knee chambers and extends, ankle/foot follows, supporting leg carries weight. Never replace a leg with a stretched straight tube. Clear anticipation, contact and retraction. All pose drawings are complete bodies; no separated rig pieces.

Use ONLY the RED character on the LEFT of the reference. EXCLUDE the blue character completely. Preserve the bright red swept spiky head, huge yellow oval eyes with black pupils, rounded red nose, friendly wide smile, long slender red neck/body, thin red arms, low red legs and rounded red feet. No clothing, no blue skin, no hat. The small hand-held yellow item is put away before combat. Draw EMPTY RED HANDS throughout all32cells. No yellow objects anywhere except the two EYES. This simplified combat silhouette must stay consistent through every pose. Its head silhouette and eyes must remain recognizable. Body is slender and elongated; two visible low leg roots stay below the long belly.

Row 1: relaxed combat guard; subtle exhale guard; forward guarded step with near foot leading; weight passes over near planted foot.
Row 2: forward guarded step with far foot leading; weight passes over far planted foot; forward dash with low lean and both legs anatomically connected; jump anticipation with hips lowered and knees bent.
Row 3: rising jump with both low-rooted knees gathered; falling jump with legs extending for landing; low crouched landing with both soles grounded; PUNCH WINDUP with front fist pulled BACK NEXT TO THE RIBS, elbow deeply bent, shoulder coiling; absolutely no extended arms here.
Row 4: fully extended straight punch toward the right; punch retracting to guard; uppercut low-body coil; clear rising uppercut with elbow then fist high, two legs retained.
Row 5: side kick chamber, near knee lifted from LOW hip, support foot planted; half-extended kick with knee opening; fully extended waist-height side kick, low hip, ankle and toes aligned; kick knee retracts high to chest with supporting foot planted; BOTH feet must NOT touch ground yet.
Row 6: low sweeping kick with one grounded bent support leg; sweep recovery returning over the low pelvis; airborne kick chamber with both legs originating at lower body; airborne kick full extension with coherent second leg folded.
Row 7: recoiling from a chest hit, head and torso remain joined; solid two-arm high guard; reaching forward to catch with clearly visible open hand; close grab hold with both arms bent toward an imagined opponent but NO opponent drawn.
Row 8: forward throw release with planted low legs and torso follow-through, no opponent; ranged power anticipation with hands close to chest; ranged power release with front hand extended, no projectile; broad triumphant Team Special impact stance with both arms and both legs visible.
